source.title: Tipologi Tata Ruang Dalam Rumah Adat Kampung Marapu Anakalang
source.authors: Arfie Pigan Solissa & Zhygit Archiva Umbu Saki Pekulimu

baga_haga_uma.name: Baga Haga Uma
baga_haga_uma.note: Public zone and ritual stage. The paper marks longer terraces in Kedabura, Uma Wajal and Kedakadi as a sign of status and ritual intensity.
baga_haga_uma.note_id: Zona publik dan panggung ritual. Paper mencatat teras yang lebih panjang pada Kedabura, Uma Wajal, dan Kedakadi sebagai penanda status dan intensitas ritual.

ana_kajaka.name: Ana Kajaka
ana_kajaka.note: Daily seat for guests; becomes the seat of the jubir (adat spokesman) during ceremonies. Two units in five houses, one in three.
ana_kajaka.note_id: Tempat duduk tamu sehari-hari; menjadi kursi jubir (juru bicara adat) saat upacara. Dua unit di lima rumah, satu unit di tiga rumah.

anakaja_wawa.name: Anakaja Wawa
anakaja_wawa.note: Labelled only in Uma Bakul. Coded here as a variant of Anakajaka Kerajialu (secondary women's work bale). Interpretive; re-code if field notes say otherwise.
anakaja_wawa.note_id: Hanya berlabel di Uma Bakul. Di sini dikodekan sebagai varian Anakajaka Kerajialu (bale-bale kerja perempuan sekunder). Bersifat interpretatif; ubah kodenya bila catatan lapangan berkata lain.

baga_kerajialu.name: Baga Kerajialu
baga_kerajialu.note: Women's work terrace: washing dishes, sieving rice, preparing food.
baga_kerajialu.note_id: Teras kerja perempuan: mencuci piring, menapis beras, menyiapkan makanan.

baga_baha_tabung.name: Baga Baha Tabung
baga_baha_tabung.note: Women's work strip for water and washing, on the outer edge.
baga_baha_tabung.note_id: Jalur kerja perempuan untuk air dan mencuci, di sisi luar rumah.

hedang_baha_tabung.name: Hedang Baha Tabung
hedang_baha_tabung.note: Uma Adung only: rack for water containers between kitchen annex and house.
hedang_baha_tabung.note_id: Hanya di Uma Adung: rak wadah air di antara dapur terpisah dan rumah.

baga.name: Baga
baga.note: Kedabura only, at −0.45 (the lowest floor with the kitchen).
baga.note_id: Hanya di Kedabura, pada −0,45 (lantai terendah bersama dapur).

kerajialu.name: Kerajialu
kerajialu.note: Women's work zone: preparing household and ritual meals, storing kitchen tools and clean water.
kerajialu.note_id: Zona kerja perempuan: menyiapkan hidangan rumah tangga dan ritual, menyimpan alat dapur dan air bersih.

kapenang_kerajialu.name: Kapenang Kerajialu
kapenang_kerajialu.note: Labelled in four plans (Kedabura, Kedakadi, Uma Djaga, Uma Nuku). The text discusses an 'Anakajaka Kerajialu' present in five houses; the two lists do not match.
kapenang_kerajialu.note_id: Berlabel di empat denah (Kedabura, Kedakadi, Uma Djaga, Uma Nuku). Teks membahas 'Anakajaka Kerajialu' yang ada di lima rumah; kedua daftar tidak cocok.

kapenang_uma.name: Kapenang Uma
kapenang_uma.note: The main floor reached directly from the front door in every house.
kapenang_uma.note_id: Lantai utama yang dicapai langsung dari pintu depan di setiap rumah.

halema.name: Halema
halema.note: L-shaped inner platform for sitting, gathering and sleeping. Present in all eight houses.
halema.note_id: Panggung dalam berbentuk L untuk duduk, berkumpul, dan tidur. Ada di kedelapan rumah.

ana_halema.name: Ana Halema
ana_halema.note: Uma Bakul only: small platforms wrapping the central hearth.
ana_halema.note_id: Hanya di Uma Bakul: panggung kecil yang mengelilingi tungku tengah.

padua_uma.name: Padua Uma
padua_uma.note: Inner family and gathering core. Also the name of the whole middle level (human world).
padua_uma.note_id: Inti keluarga dan ruang berkumpul. Juga nama seluruh level tengah (dunia manusia).

kapenang_karabuk.name: Kapenang Karabuk
kapenang_karabuk.note: Uma Bakul only: the hearth kept at the centre of the house, where the paper reads fire as the source of life.
kapenang_karabuk.note_id: Hanya di Uma Bakul: tungku dipertahankan di tengah rumah, dan paper membaca api sebagai sumber kehidupan.

pinu_paotung.name: Pinu Paotung
pinu_paotung.note: Moved to a separate annex in five houses, which the paper attributes to fire risk.
pinu_paotung.note_id: Dipindah ke bangunan terpisah di lima rumah; paper mengaitkannya dengan risiko kebakaran.

dapur.name: Dapur
dapur.note: Kedabura and Uma Djaga: kitchen kept inside, at the back-left corner.
dapur.note_id: Kedabura dan Uma Djaga: dapur tetap di dalam, di sudut kiri belakang.

hedang_dapur.name: Hedang Dapur
hedang_dapur.note: Storage rack for cooking tools next to the hearth.
hedang_dapur.note_id: Rak penyimpanan alat masak di samping tungku.

korung_ina_ama.name: Korung Ina-Ama
korung_ina_ama.note: The paper describes it as the deepest, most private room and the family's centre of protective energy.
korung_ina_ama.note_id: Paper menyebutnya kamar terdalam dan paling privat, pusat energi pelindung keluarga.

korung_boku_apu.name: Korung Boku-Apu
korung_boku_apu.note_id: Kamar tambahan untuk keluarga yang lebih besar.

korung_olidadi.name: Korung Olidadi
korung_olidadi.note_id: Kamar tambahan untuk keluarga yang lebih besar.

korung_balang.name: Korung Balang
korung_balang.note: Uma Adung: an internal granary room.
korung_balang.note_id: Uma Adung: kamar lumbung di dalam rumah.

korung.name: Korung
korung.note: Uma Bakul: labelled only as Korung.

pinu_korung_marapu.name: Pinu Korung Marapu
pinu_korung_marapu.note: Uma Bakul only: seat of spiritual authority for Marapu ritual and dialogue.
pinu_korung_marapu.note_id: Hanya di Uma Bakul: tempat duduk otoritas spiritual untuk ritual dan dialog Marapu.

unlabeled.name: Unlabelled room
unlabeled.note: Ladu Baru: an enclosed cell with no label. It sits where Uma Adung has Korung Balang.
unlabeled.note_id: Ladu Baru: sel tertutup tanpa label. Posisinya sama dengan Korung Balang di Uma Adung.

hedang.name: Hedang
hedang.note: Rack for household utensils and ready food.
hedang.note_id: Rak untuk perabot rumah tangga dan makanan siap saji.

hedang_korung.name: Hedang Korung
hedang_korung.note: Rack for personal goods above the rooms.
hedang_korung.note_id: Rak barang pribadi di atas kamar.

umadalu_korung.name: Umadalu Korung
umadalu_korung.note: Loft for personal items, mats, farm tools and ritual instruments (gong, drum).
umadalu_korung.note_id: Loteng untuk barang pribadi, tikar, alat tani, dan alat ritual (gong, tambur).

umadalu_padua_uma.name: Umadalu Padua Uma
umadalu_padua_uma.note: Loft above the central bay; in Uma Wajal it also stores mats and basic needs.
umadalu_padua_uma.note_id: Loteng di atas bentang tengah; di Uma Wajal juga menyimpan tikar dan kebutuhan dasar.

umadalu_jaga_wogu.name: Umadalu Jaga Wogu
umadalu_jaga_wogu.note: The most sacred store, for heirlooms and seed grain. Access is led by the head of the family.
umadalu_jaga_wogu.note_id: Penyimpanan paling sakral, untuk pusaka dan bibit pangan. Aksesnya dipimpin kepala keluarga.

houses.name: Uma Bakul
houses.text: Mother house (rumah induk). Plan and materials unchanged over generations; thatch roof is obligatory. Venue of the Nyabba ritual.
houses.text_id: Rumah induk. Tata ruang dan material tidak berubah turun-temurun; atap alang-alang wajib. Tempat ritual Nyabba.

houses.name: Kedabura
houses.text: Sons-in-law must enter by the side door. The only plan with floor elevations.
houses.text_id: Anak mantu wajib masuk lewat pintu samping. Satu-satunya denah dengan peil lantai.

houses.name: Uma Wajal
houses.text: Holds the Watukaballa (lightning stone) site, which may not be publicised.
houses.text_id: Menyimpan situs Watukaballa (Batu Kilat), yang tidak boleh dipublikasikan.

houses.name: Uma Adung
houses.text: Most rooms of the eight: adds Korung Boku-Apu, Olidadi and Balang.
houses.text_id: Ruang terbanyak di antara kedelapan rumah: menambah Korung Boku-Apu, Olidadi, dan Balang.

houses.name: Kedakadi
houses.text: Gathering house of the Kedamaki clan for adat rituals.
houses.text_id: Rumah berkumpul suku Kedamaki untuk ritual adat.

houses.name: Ladu Baru
houses.text: Gathering house for weddings, funerals and other adat events.
houses.text_id: Rumah berkumpul untuk pernikahan, kematian, dan acara adat lainnya.

houses.name: Uma Djaga
houses.text: Hawu clan house; kitchen integrated at the back.
houses.text_id: Rumah suku Hawu; dapur menyatu di bagian belakang.

houses.name: Uma Nuku
houses.text: Hawu clan house; kitchen in a separate annex.
houses.text_id: Rumah suku Hawu; dapur di bangunan terpisah.
